# ui.byronwade.com

> Meridian — cinematic design theme for AIs. Typed grammar. shadcn primitives. Not a custom component zoo.

Browsers hitting these URLs get designed HTML. Agents receive this raw text
(`Accept: text/markdown` / `text/plain`, or `?raw=1`).

## For agents

- [design.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/design.md): AI contract (frozen vs creative, OKLCH, contrast)
- [agents.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/agents.md): Strict operating manual — load order, Fluent 2 + Cursor mapping, skills, gates
- [architecture.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/architecture.md): System layers
- [llms.txt](https://ui.byronwade.com/llms.txt): This discovery map
- Theme grammar lives in-repo at lib/design/

## Skill loop (prove on site)

1. Theme → https://ui.byronwade.com/theme · skill meridian-theme
2. Surface → https://ui.byronwade.com/surfaces · skill meridian-surface
3. Compose → https://ui.byronwade.com/surfaces#proofs · skill meridian-compose
4. Cinematic → https://ui.byronwade.com/ · skill meridian-cinematic
5. A11y → https://ui.byronwade.com/theme#contrast · skill meridian-a11y

## Research specs (ranked merge)

- [System index](https://ui.byronwade.com/system): All detailed specs + DNA
- [influences](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/influences) · [meridian](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/meridian) · [sources](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/sources)
- [layout](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/layout) · [ux](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/ux) · [animations](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/animations)
- [color](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/color) · [typography](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/typography) · [density](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/density)
- [ai-surfaces](https://ui.byronwade.com/system/ai-surfaces)
- Repo paths: `docs/*.md`

## Showcase

- [Theme](https://ui.byronwade.com/theme): Laws, knobs, workbench proof, contrast pairs
- [Surfaces](https://ui.byronwade.com/surfaces): Workbench + composer + four density lanes
- [Skills](https://ui.byronwade.com/skills): Top agent skills with on-site proofs
- [System](https://ui.byronwade.com/system): Ranked research specs
- [Home](https://ui.byronwade.com/): Cinematic film covering the full skill loop

## Install skills

```bash
npx skills add byronwade/ui.byronwade.com
npx skills add byronwade/ui.byronwade.com --skill meridian-theme
```

## Enforce

- npm run check:design
- npm run check:contrast
- TypeScript unions in lib/design/grammar.ts
- Cinematic + material laws in lib/design/recipes.ts
